guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: jangly Vox chime with bright 12-string attack
tone.profile: jangly Vox chime with bright 12-string attack
tone.summary: A compressed, bright signal chain using a Boost for initial punch, followed by an AC30-style amp and US 2x12 cab, enhanced with Chorus (used subtly) and Room reverb for vintage sheen.

rig.name: The Beatles - A Hard Day's Night - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Achieve the required compressed strum and sustain.
Provide a subtle lift and brightness to enhance the 'jangly' attack without adding grit.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD for pure tone enhancement.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Vox AC30 sound, known for its chime and upper mids.
Mimic the open-back 2x12 cabinet suggested by the gear clues.
Boost the bright upper mids and treble frequencies for maximum 'chime' and jangle.
Add subtle width and vintage sheen without sounding like a modern chorus effect.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly advises dropping Chorus, but it is used here subtly to enhance the '12-string sheen' and fullness required for the jangle sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide a natural, vintage room ambience to complete the classic pop sound.
Placeholder for delay (kept inactive as per 'avoid' list).

improvements.summary: Refine cabinet realism by swapping the generic 2x12 IR for a more vintage, open-back British cab to better match the Vox AC30/Rickenbacker aesthetic.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage open-back UK cabinet IR (e.g., 1x12 or 2x12)
proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is too modern; a vintage British cab enhances the Vox/Rickenbacker chime.
